title: Integrations
description: Connect the tools your company uses.
adminOnly: An admin can manage your company’s integrations.

toggl.title: Toggl Track
toggl.intro: Try Timeclock alongside Toggl. An admin connects the workspace and matches people once; completed time entries then sync in both directions every 10 minutes.
toggl.unavailable: Your server administrator needs to configure an integration secret key before connecting Toggl.
toggl.queued: Sync requested. The background worker will pick it up shortly.
toggl.disconnected: Toggl disconnected. Recorded time has been kept.
toggl.disconnectDescription: This stops syncing and removes the saved token, all person, project and entry mappings, and sync state. Imported time, customers and projects stay in Timeclock. Reconnecting requires a new setup.
toggl.tokenHint: Use a Toggl admin’s API token from their profile settings. The account needs permission to view and edit the team’s time.
toggl.tokenKept: Leave blank to keep the saved token. Enter a replacement if permissions or credentials have changed.
toggl.noWorkspaces: No workspaces with admin access were found for this token.
toggl.historyPending: Importing history. Recent time syncs while older entries are brought in.
toggl.historyProgress: History checked through {date}. Older entries continue importing automatically.
toggl.historyComplete: Historical scan complete. Entries needing attention are listed below.
toggl.fromHint: Import all available history for matched people, or choose a starting date (midnight UTC). Large histories import in batches and resume automatically after API limits.
toggl.matchHint: Review the email matches below. Only matched people sync; employees do not need to connect their accounts. Existing matches cannot be reassigned while connected.
toggl.scope: Customers and projects are imported from Toggl. Use those projects when tracking in either app. Running timers transfer after they stop. Time off, rates, tags, tasks and payroll approvals are not synced. Submitted timesheets stay locked; conflicts require a decision here.
toggl.connected: Toggl connected. Sync will begin shortly.
toggl.resolveDescription: The chosen version will be applied on the next sync. Payroll locks still apply.
toggl.retryWarning: Check Toggl first. Only retry if the previous attempt did not create an entry. Retrying an entry that already exists can create a duplicate.

issues.conflict: Both versions changed. Choose which version to keep.
issues.missing_remote: This entry is missing or inaccessible in Toggl. Confirm the deletion before removing it from Timeclock, or keep Timeclock’s version to create it again.
issues.ownership_changed: The Toggl entry changed workspace or person. Restore its original ownership in Toggl before syncing.
issues.creation_uncertain: Toggl may have created this entry before the connection failed. Link the existing entry, or confirm it is absent before retrying. New imports for this person wait until this is resolved.
issues.locked: This entry touches a submitted or approved timesheet. Return the timesheet for changes before syncing it.
issues.project_required: Timeclock requires a project. Add one in Toggl before syncing this entry.
issues.description_required: Timeclock requires a description. Add one in Toggl before syncing this entry.
issues.invalid_entry: This entry could not be synced. Check its dates, description and project. Outgoing entries must use a project imported from Toggl.
